data_fields.name: stage_respawn_points
data_fields.donor_constant: 8 coordinate pairs, one per virtue (e.g. 231,136 first)

data_fields.name: turn_away_roll_byte
data_fields.donor_constant: turnAway byte per NPC, roll via xu4_random(0x100)

best_idea: A quest is a ladder of stages with three misses per stage, each stage ejecting to its own respawn point, and positive reward gains allowed once per fixed time bucket while losses always apply.
decision_why: Keep the three-try ladder with per-stage respawn and the bucketed positive-gain throttle with the wrap defect fixed; replace typed answers with server-verified state checks because text answers do not fit a fast fight.
acceptance: Three misses on one stage eject once to that stage respawn point and end the attempt; a correct answer resets the miss count; a second positive karma gain in the same 16-move bucket is refused while a negative change still applies.
